title: cloezia microphylla
intro: Cloezia microphylla, commonly known as the Ceylon ironwood, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities, thereby providing various health benefits such as wound healing and the prevention of certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of Cloezia microphylla include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as limonoids, flavonoids, and coumarins, among others, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
